DLC2306:4:t_005:3.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「$$勝平$$ is right! We can't let a little damage scare us off!」

DLC2306:4:t_005:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「That's right! Those are the hopes entrusted to you... to $$ザンボット３$$!」

DLC2306:4:t_005:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$恵子$$ carries the 'love' to bestow kindness, $$宇宙太$$ the 'courage' to challenge the vast galaxy, and $$勝平$$ the 'power' to overcome hardship!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:2.en:
$$アキラ$$
「That gutsy spirit! You're a true classic super robot pilot!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Who cares about classic or authentic!? I'm $$神勝平$$!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right, $$勝平$$! And just as two fires join to become a blaze, the three of you unite to become love, courage, and power!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Fight, $$勝平$$! Forget what anyone thinks of you. Fight for what you believe in and what you want to protect!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah! Let's do it, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:8.en:
$$恵子$$
「The hopes our fathers and mothers entrusted to us...! With those, we can fight!」

DLC2306:4:t_007:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Here we come, $$新地球皇国$$! With love, courage, and power combined, we'll take the Earth back from you!」

DLC2306:4:t_008:0.en:
$$恵子$$
「Enemy annihilation confirmed. There don't seem to be any more reinforcements.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Now that it's over, we've won a complete victory.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm the hero of the day!」

DLC2306:4:t_008:3.en:
$$恵子$$
「There you go getting carried away again, $$勝平$$!」

DLC2306:4:t_008:4.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「You're still a long way from a classic hero if you're acting like that.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't care about that anymore! I'm me!」

DLC2306:4:t_008:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Thanks, $$ノリコ$$. ...And while I'm at it, I'm sorry I treated you like you were in the way just because you're a girl.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Now that I've seen you in action, I get it. You're a super robot pilot through and through.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm glad to hear you say that.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:10.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「That settles the classic-hero question, then.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:11.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「I thought he'd understand in time, but I never imagined it would be settled in a single night...」

DLC2306:4:t_008:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「It means $$勝平$$'s growing far faster than we expected.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:13.en:
$$勝平$$
「Of course I am. I can't embarrass myself with the moon watching me.」

DLC2306:4:t_008:14.en:
$$勝平$$
（$$万丈$$... I'll become the moon that lights the dark night with love, courage, and power.）

DLC2306:4:t_008:15.en:
$$勝平$$
（It doesn't matter what's classic. That's my fight.）

DLC2306:4:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
（Love, courage, and power... What do they have to do with us...?）

DLC2306:4:t_100:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「Focus, $$勝平$$! The enemy's right in front of us!」

DLC2306:4:t_100:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! I know that without you telling me!」

DLC2306:4:t_100:3.en:
$$恵子$$
「What are you two doing!? We're in the middle of a battle!」

DLC2306:4:t_100:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Damn it! I'll take this frustration out on the enemy!」

DLC2306:4:t_101:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Love, courage, and power... Those are the hopes our names carry...」

DLC2306:4:t_101:1.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We've got to live up to those hopes.」

DLC2306:4:t_101:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「That's right. We're representing the $$神ファミリー$$.」

DLC2306:4:t_101:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Let's do this! With love, courage, and power united, there's nothing to fear!」

DLC2306:4:t_101:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Prepare yourselves, $$新地球皇国$$! We're not the same as we were a moment ago!」

DLC2306:4:t_101:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「I... We'll become the moon that lights the dark night!!」

DLC2306:4:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
（When you have no confidence in yourself and want to reject everything...）

DLC2306:4:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
（$$勝平$$ is just like I was when Big Sis broke up our partnership.）

DLC2306:4:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
（That's why I want him to overcome it...! With a super robot pilot's unbreakable guts!）

DLC2306:4:t_103:0.en:
$$タケル$$
（$$勝平$$ has overcome sorrow, pain and fear to keep fighting...）

DLC2306:4:t_103:1.en:
$$タケル$$
（That's why I'm sure he can find his own reason to fight. The wish for love, courage and power lives within him and his friends.）

DLC2306:4:t_104:0.en:
$$ミカ$$
「$$勝平$$... He really does seem off his game.」

DLC2306:4:t_104:1.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「He's forcing himself to get fired up, but he just seems to be spinning his wheels.」

DLC2306:4:t_104:2.en:
$$アキラ$$
「A classic super robot pilot, huh...? Does it really matter that much?」

DLC2306:4:t_104:3.en:
$$ナオト$$
「It doesn't concern us, since we pilot the $$コスモクラッシャー$$.」

DLC2306:4:t_104:4.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「What are you talking about!? Our fighting spirit is no different from a robot pilot's!」

DLC2306:4:t_104:6.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Get fired up! Don't forget that we're fighting on behalf of all of $c right now!」

review.context: Takeru explains the symbolic hopes in Keiko, Uchuta and Kappei's names. Kappei accepts his own identity and apologizes to Noriko; battle variants contrast his frustration before and confidence after this realization.
decisions: The name wordplay is conveyed through kindness, the galaxy and overcoming hardship while retaining the exact character-name tokens.
Noriko's two-fires image refers to combining the written fire radicals into flame; English preserves the image without adding exposition.
Zambot Cutter is an attack name absent from the brief glossary and uses the established Zambot spelling.
Noriko's Big Sis refers to her former partner Kazumi, not a newly inferred literal sister.
